personal.bio:
Hey 👋😄
I'm Iván, an Industrial Engineer who loves building smart things with AI. I’ve worked on projects in computer vision 👁️, RAG systems 📚✨ and automation ⚙️, both in research 🧑‍🔬 and industry 🏭 at Bosch. I’m curious 🧐, hands-on 🛠️, and always looking for new ways to make technology practical and useful 🚀. Outside of work, I enjoy spending time with friends 👥🎉 — if you appreciate that too, contact me for a water anytime 🍺😉

experience.description: Worked on AI-powered assistants and data engineering workflows within Bosch’s Library Intelligence Xperience (LIX) team. Developed a private RAG system using Azure OpenAI, LangChain, and Chroma for technical documentation. Built structured pipelines for evaluation and document retrieval, integrating Pydantic parsing, Hydra configs, and Deepeval testing. Collaborated with international teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.

Conducted research on LLM workflows for scientific papers. Built an end-to-end pipeline to process raw PDFs from arXiv, generate text fragments with Mixtral8x7B and Qwen, and fine-tune LLaMA3 and Gemma models for conversational assistants. Designed evaluation frameworks and contributed to experiments on context retrieval and summarization.

projects.title: Automated Sorting Plant Digital Twin
projects.description: Designed and implemented a digital twin of an automated factory for parcel classification, storage, and distribution using Siemens TIA Portal V17 and Factory I/O. Developed the entire control logic in Graph language and integrated an HMI screen for intuitive operator interaction. The virtual plant was composed of multiple zones with conveyors, sensors, actuators, and robots, replicating a real logistics workflow. The system improved process efficiency, reduced operational risks, and enabled rapid testing of automation strategies before real-world deployment.

projects.title: ABB Dual Manipulator Digital Twin
projects.description: Developed a basic digital twin to simulate the coordinated and individual behavior of two ABB manipulators working in parallel. The system replicated the real production line scenario, enabling quick prototyping, faster testing, and better understanding of the synchronized robot operations.

projects.title: Smart Irrigation Digital Twin
projects.description: Designed and implemented an autonomous smart irrigation system using a dsPIC33FJ32MC202 microcontroller. The project simulated a digital twin of a domestic cultivation zone, controlling soil humidity, temperature, and solar irradiation through actuators. Features included a soil moisture sensor activating a servo-driven valve, a fan regulated by a thermistor, and a motorized awning controlled by a photoresistor. The system operated in multiple states, adapting irrigation, ventilation, and shading dynamically to environmental conditions, allowing rapid testing and validation of control strategies.
